title: expand_url_template allocates N+1 Strings in loop
description: blob.rs expand_url_template (lines 33-41): iterates over vars slice calling String::replace each iteration. Each replace allocates a new String even when no substitution matches, plus a format! allocation for the placeholder. With the download-blob call site (4 vars) this is 8 allocations minimum. Hot path for every blob upload and download. Fix: single-pass substitution scanning the template once.
